source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 12.5, PDF page 306 (printed p. 301)
about: Table 12.5, "The parameters of the plate-fibre system": the 0.9 x 0.6 m double plate of a steel panel, a foam and a limp heavy layer, computed twice, once with a limp foam and once with an elastic foam (Figures 12.13 and 12.14). Columns as printed: thickness h (mm), phi, sigma (N s/m4), alpha_inf, Lambda (um), Lambda' (um), rho_1 (kg/m3), E (Pa), nu and eta_s. The two foams are the two porous rows; the elastic one is the foam of Tables 11.5, 12.1 and 12.4. The steel panel (1 mm, 7800 kg/m3, printed E 2.1e10 where Table 12.2 prints 2.1e11 for its steel plate, nu 0.3, eta 0.007) and the heavy PVC layer (1 mm, 1000 kg/m3) are not porous materials and are not here.
